Description.English: Under the influence of upper-level disturbances and the associated unstable airstream, showers are expected in Macao at first today (14th Nov). Showers will be heavy at times, with a few thunderstorms. Weather conditions will gradually turn sunny during the day. The public is advised to pay attention to weather changes and follow the alerts and warnings issued by the DSMG.( Update Time: 2026-11-14 00H05 )
